title: 14-BCV-003 - Wind data for low-rise buildings guideline
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide, as stated by the STANDATA)
catalogue_status: Both 14-BCV-003 and 14-BCV-003R1 are explicitly marked [WITHDRAWN] in the catalogue.

facts.text: The catalogue lists original 14-BCV-003 and 14-BCV-003R1; both rows are marked withdrawn.

The R1 STANDATA references Article 9.7.4.3 and permits specified driving-rain wind-pressure and wind-load values from a named low-rise Part 9 fenestration guideline, in place of project-specific engineering when the guideline scope and limitations are met.
